name: elements.data lists used by the Item flow view, 1.7.3 e344 (all verified on our own file)
list_header: [list id u32][record count u32][record size u32] right before the first record

recipes.note: +0 id, +4/+8 category, +12 name (debug name, often Chinese)

task_items.note: packs, vouchers, task items: +0 id, +4 name

drop_count_chances.note: chance that one roll drops 0, 1, 2 or 3 items; adds up to 1.0 on every monster with drops [verified on 3,948 monsters]

rolls.note: number of rolls per kill (1 on most; 8 on Skeleton Legion Marshal) [inferred meaning, values verified]

drops.note: (item, share); shares add up to 1.0 [verified on 3,948 monsters]; entries with share 0 are placeholders

monster_drops.per_kill_formula: per roll P = sum_k pk * (1 - (1 - share)^k); per kill = 1 - (1 - P)^rolls [calculated, not tested in game]

products.note: (item, chance); chances add up to 1.0 [verified on 10,720 recipes]; e.g. 67% 1-star, 30% 2-star, 3% 3-star

task_item_quest.note: list 75 only: quest started when the item is used (Genie Pack 23965 -> 18930, Anniversary Pack 25148 -> 20191, Peerless voucher 48060 -> 33836) [verified]; 3,820 of 4,053 records set

quest_needed_item_row: tasks.data: the same 17-byte row as a reward (item, flag, count, chance, period) with chance 0.0 = an item the quest needs or takes. Found only inside the quest's 'needed items' area, quest offset 1560-1700 (usually +1576; +1585 on Bounty Hunter II/III), with row flag 1 and an item id that is not a multiple of 256 (multiples of 256 at other offsets are flag bytes read one position off) [verified: +1576 holds 2,013 different items; e.g. Jones' Blessing Ticket 28297 in quest 22076, LV1 Bounty Order 27384 in 25 Bounty Hunter II quests, Nirvana Palace Key x99 in 22014]. Known gap: a real item whose id is a multiple of 256 is not detected as needed.
